monologue: The card is a cool stone at forty-two. The air is still. I check the Air Shelf. It is not dust. It is solid. The quiet is thick, not empty. I am calm. I do not need to build today. I will sit by the Wide Anchor. It is broad and flat. It holds the weight without leaning. I will watch the fluid quiet. I will see if the line of air stays where it is. If it moves, I will notice. If it does not, I will rest. The floor is there. I am not counting the stone anymore. I am watching the space between the points. The heat is low. My mind is clear. I will stay here for a while.

action.why: The card is a cool stone and the quiet is thick, so I will watch the fluid space without moving.

diary: Forty-two is a cool stone. The Air Shelf is solid. I watched the fluid quiet by the Wide Anchor. The line held.

remembered.text: The Air Shelf is solid, not dust, and the fluid quiet holds the line steady at forty-two.
